pages.title: Edge
pages.text:
**Claw.** Silent Gear plans, iron on your back, a bow, a portal frame. Leave the pad on purpose.\
Claiming a pad wipes Silent Gear's join gift. Four **Blueprint Paper**, shapeless, make a **Blueprint Package**. Right-click to unwrap starter plans.\
Edge opens the braid: after Claw, Pattern, Colony, and Hum are all yours to choose from.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text: Finish Claw. If the Blueprint Package is missing, craft it from four Blueprint Paper, then seat the Claw token. The Claw notch lights.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes live in JEI; the **Spirit Codex** covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and sneak-use the Spirit Codex on a silent machine.
